Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We generated $13.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 15% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $19.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 125 basis points to 38.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 125 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
